title: Emergency Management Controller
description: Cloud-layer controller. Configuration: a CRI tracking service (S1) selects the CRI of the device's zone from the MGA CRI maps and returns it with the number of priority ranks N (the number of CP output classes, defined by the FLC); whenever the CRI of a zone changes by more than the EMC's change threshold (a parameter not fixed by the model), it invokes updatePriority on every EDU registered in that zone. Emergency: consumes alarm events and forwards each alarm envelope unchanged to the EMU(s) serving its hazard factor. Mitigation commands do not pass through the EMC.

configure.title: Configure EDU
configure.description: Configuration phase (E1 -> S1/S2). The hazard factors route the EDU's alarms to EMUs and define which Hazard Perception the EDU measures; they do not select the CRI.
